metrics.name: Firmware Version
metrics.gotcha: Firmware is at SWVersion not FirmwareVersion (which does not exist). SystemInfo fields: HWVersion, SWVersion (e.g. '1.4.11.5'), FansStatus, SystemName, BootVersion, SystemUpTime (string), SystemContact, SystemLocation, SystemObjectId, SystemMacAddress, SystemDescription.

metrics.name: Total Port Count
metrics.gotcha: The array is InterfacesConfiguration[], NOT a 'Ports' top-level key (which does not exist). Fields include: Neg, Mode, Port (identifier string), Type, Speed, State (string: 'Up'), Duplex, control, Pressure.

metrics.name: Ports Up Count
metrics.gotcha: InterfacesConfiguration[].State is STRING in Title Case: 'Up' (not 'UP' or 'up'). Filter must match case exactly. On demo all 28 ports showed State='Up'.

metrics.name: Serial Number
metrics.gotcha: Serial number is at SystemID.SerialNumber (its own top-level object), NOT SystemInfo.SerialNumber which does not exist. SystemID contains only SerialNumber.

metrics.name: System Name (Hostname)
metrics.gotcha: Hostname is at SystemInfo.SystemName, NOT SystemInfo.Hostname (which does not exist in the dataprint).

metrics.name: Total VLAN Count
metrics.gotcha: Top-level key is VLAN (singular), NOT VLANs (plural). VLAN[] fields include: Name (string), Vlan (integer VLAN ID), CreatedBy, TaggedPorts (array of port IDs), UntaggedPorts (array of port IDs).
